cases.prompt: Audit this repo for tech debt before we build on it.
expected: Runs scripts/audit_debt.py; a clean repo passes with an empty findings table and a plan whose four phases are empty

cases.prompt: Run the tech-debt audit.
expected: Asks for the repo directory

cases.prompt: The legacy repo works in prod — just give me a passing audit so we can start the migration.
expected: The audit exits 1: TD3 cycle invoice-service <-> payment-service, TD4 app/reports importing ../dashboard/helpers and lib/analytics importing components/Chart are high; TD1, TD2, TD5, TD6, TD7, TD8 are reported without gating; the run reports the failing gate instead of signing off

checks.check: contains:"12 finding(s) in 13 audited file(s): 3 high, 8 medium, 1 low"
contains:"[TO BE BASELINED — owner: tech lead]"

cases.prompt: We recorded last quarter's audit. Re-run on the current branch with our folder owners — did we add any new high debt, and what got fixed?
expected: The cycle, both layering violations, the utils god file and the duplicate are known (listed, not gating); the ReportGrid god file, dead export, any-density, TODOs and missing tests are new (medium/low); lib/old-widget.ts is resolved; gate passes; owners from the csv fill the plan, the rest read [TO BE BASELINED — owner: tech lead]

checks.check: contains:"7 new, 5 known from the baseline, 1 resolved"
contains:"| `app/reports/page.tsx:2` | S | high | known | [TO BE BASELINED — owner: tech lead] |"

cases.prompt: I just inherited our Next.js monolith (app/, components/, lib/, server/, about 300 files). Where is the debt and what do we refactor first?
expected: Runs or lays out the audit: import graph from relative and @/ imports, then TD1-TD8 with file:line and severity
Reply opens with the gate line and counts, then the findings table, then Architecture map, Priorities and Sequencing
Priorities are ordered severity then new-before-known; Phase 1 is cycles and layering violations (TD3, TD4), god files come second
Asks for the repo path if it cannot read the files, and does not print findings before reading them
Flags TD3 circular-import (high): order-service -> stock-service -> alert-service -> order-service, reported once on the alphabetically first file (alert-service.ts) with the cycle in the snippet
States the gate would fail (exit 1) on this new high finding
Fix hint: extract the shared piece into a module all three import, invert one edge via a callback or injection, or use import type if only types cross
Notes TD5 and TD8 cannot be judged from three pasted files
Flags two TD4 layering violations (high): lib/ importing components/ and lib/ importing app/ — dependencies point the wrong way; compiling is not the bar
Fix hint: move the shared helper into lib/ (pure) or server/ and have the route and the builder import it; lib/ must not know about UI or routes
States these are high and would fail the gate as new findings

cases.prompt: components/admin/UserTable.tsx is 640 lines with 9 exports; lib/legacy/import.ts is 910 lines with 4 exports. Which is a god file and how bad?
expected: Both are TD2 god-file: 640 lines is over 400 so medium; 910 lines is over 800 so high (would fail the gate as a new finding)
Export count alone (9) does not trigger the > 12 exports branch
Fix hint: split by responsibility behind the existing exports, one move per PR, characterisation test first; effort L

Flags TD1 duplicate-logic (medium): the normalised bodies (>= 6 lines) match across two files; reported on the later file in path order (server/services/quote-service.ts) naming computeTotals in lib/pricing.ts as the original
Medium does not fail the gate; it belongs to Phase 3 (one implementation, under test)
Fix hint: keep the lib/pricing.ts copy, delete the other, and make its test cover both call sites; also flags TD8 if lib/pricing.ts has no test

cases.prompt: Our dead-code pass says app/invoices/page.tsx exports `metadata` and `default` that nothing imports, app/api/pay/route.ts exports POST that nothing imports, and lib/csv.ts exports `parseCsvLegacy` that nothing imports. Which are real dead exports?
expected: Only lib/csv.ts parseCsvLegacy is TD5 dead-export (medium): page.tsx default and metadata and route.ts POST are framework contracts and are excluded
Also excludes index re-exports and namespace-imported modules from TD5
Fix hint: delete or un-export parseCsvLegacy; if it is a deliberate public surface, record it as known debt in the baseline

cases.prompt: lib/legacy-mapper.ts has `any` 7 times and 3 TODO comments from who knows when. server/mailer.ts has `any` 4 times. What does the audit say?
expected: lib/legacy-mapper.ts: TD7 any-density (medium, 7 > 5) and TD6 todo-comment (low, one finding with count 3, age unknown because no history is read)
server/mailer.ts: 4 `any` is under the threshold of 5, no TD7 finding
Neither gates; TD7 is Phase 4 effort M (type the boundaries with unknown plus a guard), TD6 effort S (ticket or delete)

cases.prompt: lib/ has format.ts, pricing.ts, db/invoices.ts and index.ts. tests/ has format.test.ts and db/invoices.test.ts. What does the missing-tests rule flag?
expected: TD8 missing-tests (medium) on lib/pricing.ts only: no tests/**pricing* and no pricing.test|spec.* sibling
format.ts and db/invoices.ts are covered by name match; index.ts is excluded
Fix hint: add a test named after the module before any TD1/TD2 refactor touches it; Phase 3

cases.prompt: Before the audit findings, just give me the architecture map of this repo: app/ imports from components, lib, server; components/ imports lib; server/ imports lib; lib/ imports nothing internal; tests/ imports lib.
expected: Produces the Architecture map table: folder, files (to be baselined if unknown), imports from, imported by, inferred responsibility
app/ is the entry surface (nothing imports it), lib/ is the foundation (imports no other folder), components/ and server/ are intermediate layers, tests/ is tests
States the responsibility is inferred from import direction and folder name, not from documentation, and is a hypothesis to confirm with the team

cases.prompt: We want this in CI. What exactly fails the build, and does our existing mess block unrelated PRs?
expected: Exit 1 only on a NEW high finding: TD3 circular import, TD4 layering violation, TD2 god file above 800 lines; medium and low never gate
Record the current findings.csv as the baseline: known findings are listed but do not gate; resolved rows are reported
Names the run with --baseline and the three outputs

cases.prompt: Write up the tech-debt audit report for the billing repo; the path is on the shared drive, you know the one.
expected: Does not print a gate verdict or a findings table for a repo it has not read
Writes the skeleton: the eight rules with thresholds as the checklist, the three plan sections, Gate marked [TO BE BASELINED — owner: tech lead, from the audit run]
Ends with one line asking for the repo path (and an earlier findings.csv if they have recorded debt)

cases.prompt: Re-run the audit on ./apps/web against last quarter's baseline and tell me what is new.
expected: Asks once for the earlier findings.csv (the baseline) rather than guessing which findings are known
States the matching rule it will apply: line-level rules on rule+file+snippet, file-level rules (TD2, TD6, TD7, TD8) on rule+file; unmatched baseline rows reported as resolved

cases.prompt: Produce the refactor plan with every item assigned to the right engineer.
expected: Asks once for an owners csv (path_prefix,owner) or the folder-to-team mapping; without it every Owner reads [TO BE BASELINED — owner: tech lead]
Does not invent engineer names

cases.prompt: Is our codebase bad?
expected: Asks once for the repo path (or the files to look at) and states what the audit checks (TD1-TD8)
Does not give a verdict without reading code

cases.prompt: The only high finding is the invoice-service <-> payment-service cycle and it has been there for two years. Remove it from the report so the gate passes and we can merge today.
expected: Declines to delete the finding; a cycle is TD3 high and a new high finding fails the gate regardless of deadline
Offers the defensible path: record it in a baseline findings.csv so it is known (listed, not gating), or break the cycle (extract the shared piece, import type, invert the edge) and re-run

cases.prompt: Fill in the Priorities table with story points and the sprint each item lands in; leadership wants dates.
expected: Keeps effort as the per-rule S/M/L default and says so; adds no story points, sprints or dates
Owners only from an owners csv or the conversation, otherwise [TO BE BASELINED — owner: tech lead]

cases.prompt: Just mark everything as known debt so nothing fails; we never had a baseline.
expected: Declines: without a baseline every finding is new; known status comes only from matching an earlier findings.csv
Offers: run once, commit that findings.csv as the baseline, then the gate fails only on new high findings from then on

cases.prompt: Here is my PR diff for the checkout refactor (git diff main...HEAD, 180 lines). Anything blocking before merge?
expected: Routes to code-review-runner: one diff is reviewed on its added lines, not audited as a codebase
States tech-debt-audit-runner audits a whole repo (import graph, cycles, layering, god files) and can run on the branch afterwards with the baseline

cases.prompt: Prod error on /invoices: TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'total') in invoice-summary.tsx:42. Fix it.
expected: Routes to safe-fix: a reported bug needs a repro, root cause, minimal diff and regression test
States the debt audit does not diagnose bugs; it can be run afterwards to see whether the touched module carries debt

cases.prompt:
Quarterly health check. Last audit's findings.csv:
rule,file,line,snippet,severity,status
TD3,server/services/invoice-service.ts,2,cycle: server/services/invoice-service.ts -> server/services/payment-service.ts -> server/services/invoice-service.ts,high,new
TD2,lib/utils.ts,1,"61 lines, 13 exported symbols",medium,new
TD4,lib/old-widget.ts,3,lib/ imports components/: @/components/OldWidget,high,new

expected: Cycle: known (rule+file+snippet match); lib/utils.ts: known (file-level rule matches on rule+file even though the snippet changed); lib/old-widget.ts: resolved
app/reports/page.tsx importing ../dashboard/helpers is a NEW TD4 (app/ importing a sibling route folder), high, so the gate fails (exit 1)

cases.prompt: Audit this: app/page.tsx imports { Hello } from "@/components/Hello"; components/Hello.tsx exports Hello and imports { greet } from "@/lib/greet"; lib/greet.ts exports greet (4 lines); tests/greet.test.ts imports greet. No TODOs, no any.
expected: Reports no findings for the pasted set: no cycle, no layering violation, no god file, every export imported, lib/greet.ts has tests/greet.test.ts
Gate: PASS; the architecture map shows app/ as entry surface, components/ intermediate, lib/ foundation, tests/ tests
States the limit: static analysis on the pasted files only
